name: taccuino
description: Windows desktop application - Monthly Finance Tracker built with Angular and Electron

scripts.pack:win: npm run build:frontend && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path 'frontend\dist\frontend\*' -Destination 'electron\dist\' -Recurse -Force" && npx --prefix electron @electron/packager ./electron Taccuino --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=./electron/dist-win --overwrite
scripts.build:installer: npm run build:frontend && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path 'frontend\dist\frontend\*' -Destination 'electron\dist\' -Recurse -Force" && npm run dist:installer --prefix electron

author: Antigravity Engineering
